title: RT Calculus Specification v1.0 Consolidation

basis.scope: Consolidate the governed RT Calculus surfaces into a Version 1.0 specification index without introducing new mathematical objects or theorems.

core_rule.statement: RT Calculus v1.0 is an additive consolidation index over the governed surfaces established by patches 001-044; RT_core remains unchanged and no new mathematical objects or theorems are introduced.

purpose: Consolidate the governed RT Calculus into a Version 1.0 specification by collecting existing definitions, evaluation order, reduction semantics, continuation semantics, fixed-point semantics, and governance without introducing new mathematical objects or theorems.

canonical_claims.statement: RT Calculus v1.0 collects already-governed surfaces into a single specification index.
The consolidated specification preserves the existing typing, evaluation, reduction, continuation, fixed-point, and governance layers without strengthening them.
No new mathematical objects or theorems are introduced by this consolidation.
Documentation and registries remain synchronized with the governed v1.0 release label.

adds: Consolidated documentation map for existing RT calculus surfaces

governance_requirements: All formal objects must already exist in governed registries.
Documentation and registries must remain synchronized.
validation_requirements: No new mathematical objects or theorems are introduced.
